(actor nested_call
  (interface (input request) (input allow) (input datain (width 3)) (input other (width 3)) (output seen (width 3)) (output done))
  (proc choose (params (c (width 1)) (v (width 3)) (alt (width 3)) (out dst (width 3))) (cond (c (call assign v dst)) (else (call assign alt dst)))) (proc assign (params (v (width 3)) (out dst (width 3))) (set dst v))
  
  (transaction main (on request) (call choose allow datain other seen) (complete done)))
